collisions.label: admission: admitted
collisions.proof: S10 (step_adm) and S11 (admit_by) are the two implementations of the AdmStep type ('An admission step: step_adm, or a deliberately defective one in a negative case'): both are ADM's one admission step, both spend one admission, both label 'admission: admitted' exactly when that step admitted and 'admission: refused' otherwise, and both then run admission_properties when admitted. They differ only in the admission predicate. admit_by is not reachable from any required configuration's test (vocab_check_sites.py, reachability), so every required receipt attributes these labels to S10.
